sentences.text: % 19.05.2023 1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

This application has been filed seeking interim bail for the petitioner in FIR No.870/2015 under sections 354/376 IPC registered at PS Nihal Vihar on the ground of his serious medical condition,
suffering from post operative infection after hip-replacement surgery.

The medical documents,
including certificate dated 17th November, 2022 from the K K Hospital, have been filed as per which the hip-replacement surgery was performed on the petitioner on 21st March, 2022.
2. Petitioner was granted interim bail for a period of 12 weeks by this Court vide order dated 30th August, 2022.
3. Issue notice.
Ld. APP for the State accepts notice.
4. The State shall file a status report verifying the facts from the hospital This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 17:57:11 regarding further treatment of the appellant.
5. Pursuant to an earlier direction of this Court, medical report dated 13th August, 2022 from the Medical Officer of the Jail is on record.
Fresh medical report of the appellant be called from the Jail Superintendent for the next date.
